name: MonTamer Maker
detailed_description:
What is MonMae?

MonMae (MonTamer Maker) is the ultimate monster-taming game builder — now on Steam! This is a game and tool made specifically for creating your own monster-catching RPGs from scratch, no coding required.

Craft, play, and share your own full-length games or bite-sized adventures with the Steam community using our powerful yet beginner-friendly tools and massive art libraries.

MonMae comes with a short tutorial and example game to get you up to speed on crafting an RPG of your own using our plethora of game assets that are included... or, import your own!

What comes with my purchase?

MonMae gives you everything you need out of the box to make a full monster-tamer RPG:

  • 100+ monsters with both battle and overworld sprites
  • 60+ NPCs with animations and variations
  • 40+ original music tracks
  • 8 playable characters with full animations
  • Massive tile sets, from grassy fields to mega cities
  • Full UI sets and battle animations
  • 100+ customizable moves and example scripts
  • Visual editors for maps, dialogue, events, battles, and more

Whether you’re making a 5-minute side quest or a 40-hour epic, MonMae has you covered!

What Makes This Version Special?

  • Game Sharing on Steam Workshop
    Upload your creations, or download other players’ games right from Steam!
  • Steam-Optimized Visual Editor
    Everything’s accessible, beginner-friendly, and runs smooth right on your PC.
  • No Coding Required
    Use intuitive, game-like menus to build your world, monsters, quests, and more!

Ok, but why MonMae?

  • Fun Intro Tutorial
    Do you ever find yourself getting lost with game dev? No fear! We have a fun, game-like tutorial (optional) with a short story to get you on your game dev'ving A-game!
  • Own your Engine
    Rather than releasing new versions of "MonMae" and similar projects, MonMae will be updated continuously. No more getting forced to pay full price for the same thing over and over again.
  • Full Creative Freedom
    Use your art, or ours! MonMae comes with a plethora of art, or you can import your own!
  • Advanced YouTube Tutorials Available Online
    MonMae has a YT Tutorial series to guide and answer any questions you may have

Alright, but how do I know my game will be good?

Already, there's lots of MonMae projects, including a couple on — or coming soon to — Steam! Please check out other games by us or join our Discord to learn more about MonMae projects. Our most recently released MonMae project is called Dokimon: Quest!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual core processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 10th Gen Quad core processor or newer
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 760 (or equivalent) and up
  • Storage: 500 GB available space
